cards.example_en: The doctor wrapped my wrist and told me not to play basketball.
cards.example_zh: 医生包好我的手腕，让我先别打篮球。

cards.example_en: Our dog sleeps under the table whenever we eat dumplings.
cards.example_zh: 我们一吃饺子，狗就睡到桌子底下。

cards.example_en: The child held a small doll.
cards.example_zh: 孩子抱着一个小玩偶。

cards.example_en: The notebook costs one dollar.
cards.example_zh: 这本笔记本要一美元。

cards.example_en: We donate old books to the library.
cards.example_zh: 我们把旧书捐给图书馆。

cards.example_en: A cold wind pushed the door shut while we were carrying boxes.
cards.example_zh: 我们搬箱子的时候，冷风把门带上了。

cards.example_en: We ordered a double portion of rice after the long hike.
cards.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，我们点了双份米饭。

cards.example_en: There was no doubt that her free kick would beat the keeper.
cards.example_zh: 毫无疑问，她的任意球会打过守门员。

cards.example_en: Please write it down in your notebook.
cards.example_zh: 请把它写在笔记本上。

cards.example_en: Download the city map before you leave home.
cards.example_zh: 出门之前先把城市地图下载好。

cards.example_en: A paper dragon led the parade.
cards.example_zh: 一条纸龙走在游行队伍前面。

cards.example_en: The drama about a lost dog left several people in tears.
cards.example_zh: 那出关于走失小狗的戏剧让好几个人落了泪。

cards.example_en: Draw a picture of your family for art class.
cards.example_zh: 美术课上画一张你的全家福。

cards.example_en: Flying a small plane has been his dream since a trip to the airfield.
cards.example_zh: 自从去过小型机场，开小飞机就成了他的梦想。

cards.example_en: The red dress in the window was the one she wore to the concert.
cards.example_zh: 橱窗里的那条红连衣裙，就是她去音乐会时穿的。

cards.example_en: A cold drink from the machine cost more than my bus fare.
cards.example_zh: 自动售货机里的一杯冷饮比我的车费还贵。

cards.example_en: My uncle will drive us to the science museum.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔会开车送我们去科学博物馆。

cards.example_en: The driver stopped the bus so a student could pick up her folder.
cards.example_zh: 司机把车停下，让一名学生捡起她的文件夹。

cards.example_en: The plate will drop if you hold it with one hand.
cards.example_zh: 如果你只用一只手拿，盘子就会掉下去。

cards.example_en: The towels were dry after an hour in the hot sun.
cards.example_zh: 毛巾在烈日下晒了一个小时就干了。

cards.example_en: A duck led five ducklings across the path beside the boating lake.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸭子领着五只小鸭穿过划船湖边的小路。

cards.example_en: Grandma taught me how to fold a dumpling.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶教我怎么包饺子。

cards.example_en: Please turn off your phone during the lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上课时请关掉手机。

cards.example_en: Checking the windows is my duty on the days I leave last.
cards.example_zh: 我最后离开的那些天，检查窗户是我的义务。

cards.example_en: Each student has a desk.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生都有一张课桌。

cards.example_en: An eagle flew over the valley.
cards.example_zh: 一只鹰飞过山谷。

cards.example_en: She tucked her hair behind one ear and started the listening test.
cards.example_zh: 她把头发别到一只耳朵后面，开始做听力测试。

cards.example_en: I got up early for the morning run.
cards.example_zh: 我早上很早就起床跑步了。

cards.example_en: The globe shows the earth with blue oceans and green land.
cards.example_zh: 这个地球仪上的地球有蓝色的海洋和绿色的陆地。

cards.example_en: The earthquake shook the houses at night.
cards.example_zh: 夜里地震震动了房屋。

cards.example_en: The east side of the house stays cool during hot afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 房子的东侧在炎热的下午仍然凉快。

cards.example_en: The easy questions at the start gave everyone some confidence.
cards.example_zh: 开头的简单题目给了每个人一些信心。

cards.example_en: We eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
cards.example_zh: 除夕晚上我们一起吃饺子。

cards.example_en: Free education meant my parents could stay in school until eighteen.
cards.example_zh: 因为有免费教育，我父母才能一直读到十八岁。

cards.example_en: The cough syrup had little effect, so Mum called the clinic.
cards.example_zh: 止咳糖浆几乎没有效果，妈妈就给诊所打了电话。

cards.example_en: One last effort up the hill brought her level with the leader.
cards.example_zh: 上坡时的最后一次努力让她追上了领先的人。

cards.example_en: I dropped an egg on the floor and had to clean it before class.
cards.example_zh: 我把一个鸡蛋掉在地上，上课前只好收拾干净。

cards.example_en: You can take either bus to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 您可以乘坐任意一辆巴士前往博物馆。

cards.example_en: My elder sister studies in Guangzhou.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐在广州上学。

cards.example_en: The electric fan kept our classroom bearable in June.
cards.example_zh: 电风扇让我们的教室在六月还能待下去。

cards.example_en: Electronic tickets on his phone got us into the museum.
cards.example_zh: 他手机上的电子票让我们进了博物馆。

cards.example_en: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk.
cards.example_zh: 大象用鼻子喷水。

cards.example_en: Would you like anything else?
cards.example_zh: 你还想要点别的吗？

cards.example_en: I'll send you an email with the details.
cards.example_zh: 我会向您发送一封包含详细信息的电子邮件。

cards.example_en: In an emergency, call 120.
cards.example_zh: 如遇紧急情况，请拨打120。

cards.example_en: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
cards.example_zh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

cards.example_en: The empress wrote poems in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 皇后在园子里写诗。

cards.example_en: The empty bottle rolled under the seat during the bus ride.
cards.example_zh: 空瓶子在乘公交时滚到了座位底下。

cards.example_en: Parents encourage us to read before we sleep.
cards.example_zh: 父母鼓励我们睡前读书。

cards.example_en: Stay until the end, because the last scene explains the mystery.
cards.example_zh: 请一直看到结束，因为最后一场才揭开谜底。

word.example_en: We should cut down on plastic bags.
I will not let down my team.
Old buses may break down in the heat.
word.example_zh: 旧公交车可能在高温中出故障。

word.example_en: That old shop may close down in August.
word.example_zh: 那家老店可能在八月停业关闭。

word.example_en: Good writers draw on daily life.
word.example_zh: 好的作者借鉴日常生活。

word.example_en: The class will draw up a small budget.
word.example_zh: 班级将起草一份小预算。

word.example_en: Many children dream of becoming a pilot.
word.example_zh: 许多孩子梦想成为飞行员。

word.example_en: I sometimes dream about the old campus.
The new rule will take effect in May.
Please make an effort to arrive early.
If you rush, you may end up with errors.
word.example_zh: 如果赶工，你到头来可能会出错。
